Moving again ends this period at once, and keeps the provider moved away from then in its place.

time_delete_description: This time entry will be permanently removed.
time_field_ended_at_running_hint: Leave blank to keep running, or set a time to stop it.
time_error_end_before_start: End time cannot be earlier than start time.
time_error_reopen_forbidden: A finished entry must keep an end time.
time_error_note_too_long: Note can be at most {limit} characters.
time_wall_password_title: Confirm password to record personal time
time_wall_sso_title: Sign in with SSO to record time here
course_schedule_description: Set a study period, study days, or manually redistribute remaining units.
course_schedule_no_auto_shift: Overdue units stay on their dates and do not shift automatically.
course_schedule_auto_assign: Auto-assign dates to units proportionally by amount
course_schedule_delete_hint: Clears the saved schedule range only; unit dates stay intact.
course_schedule_redistribute_mine_hint: Reassigns only your incomplete units to personal planned dates. Completed units and the shared schedule stay unchanged.
course_schedule_redistribute_shared_hint: Reassigns the shared scheduled date for every live unit in this course.
course_schedule_redistribute_shared_conf: This updates the shared scheduled date of all live units in this course. Personal planned dates are kept.
course_schedule_error_target_before_star: Target date must be on or after the start date.
course_schedule_error_span_too_long: Schedule span must be at most {max} days.
course_schedule_error_study_days: Select at least one study day.
course_schedule_error_no_study_days: No selected study day falls within the chosen date range.
course_schedule_error_target_required: Enter a target date before redistributing.
course_schedule_error_amount: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
learning_today_subtitle: Incomplete units due today and overdue across your enrolled courses.
learning_today_overdue_hint: Overdue units do not shift automatically. Complete them or redistribute them from the course schedule.
learning_today_empty_hint: Set a study schedule on any enrolled course to see today’s and overdue units here.
course_meetings_subtitle: Shared meeting schedules, linked units, presenter/host assignments, and attendance.
course_meetings_delete_info: Are you sure you want to delete the meeting “{title}”? All attendance records for this meeting will be deleted.
course_meetings_empty_hint: Schedule a study meeting to coordinate presenters, hosts, covered units, and attendance.
course_meetings_field_units_empty: No units in this course yet.
course_meetings_error_datetime: Enter a valid date and time.
course_meetings_error_location: Location must be at most 500 characters.
course_meetings_error_notes: Notes must be at most 5000 characters.
course_meetings_error_units: You can link at most {max} units.
course_meetings_error_member: The selected member is not enrolled in this course.
course_attendance_self_hint: You can update your own attendance.
course_exams_subtitle: Track exam dates, record your personal score, and compare against the course average.
course_exams_privacy_notice: Only you can see your score. The course average shows once a manager of the course publishes the results, which takes at least 5 scores.
course_exams_delete_info: Are you sure you want to delete the exam “{title}”? All recorded scores for this exam will be permanently deleted.
course_exams_empty_hint: Add an exam to track dates, record your private score, and see the course average.
course_exams_average_hidden: Shown once the results are published
course_exams_publish_refused: Not published: since the last publication, at least 3 more (or fewer) members have to have scored.
course_exams_my_note_placeholder: Reflection or areas to review (only visible to you)
course_exams_error_max_score: Enter a positive max score up to 1,000,000,000.
course_exams_error_description: Description must be at most 5000 characters.
course_exams_error_note: Note must be at most 1000 characters.
shell_settings_notify_due_hint: When a card given to you is due today or tomorrow, and when a review comes due.
shell_trash_boards_retention: Boards, wikis, diaries, and courses you administered. Items in the trash are permanently deleted after {days} days.
shell_trash_cards_retention: Cards deleted from this board. Items in the trash are permanently deleted after {days} days.
wiki_trash_retention: Pages deleted from this wiki; subpages come back with them. Items in the trash are permanently deleted after {days} days.
course_trash_retention: Chapters and units deleted from this course; units deleted with a chapter come back with it. Items in the trash are permanently deleted after {days} days.
audit_copy_out_disabled: {actor} turned copying out of the organization off
audit_copy_out_enabled: {actor} turned copying out of the organization on
org_allow_copy_out: Allow copying out of the organization
org_allow_copy_out_hint: Members may copy boards, wikis, and courses to their personal space or another organization.
shell_copy_to_workspace_description: Makes a private copy of {title} under the same title, without its comments or other members. Rename it in place once the copy opens.
shell_copy_to_workspace_disabled: This organization does not allow copying containers outside the organization.
shell_copy_to_workspace_storage_full: The destination organization does not have enough storage space.
shell_copy_to_workspace_failed: Could not copy to the selected workspace.
shell_copy_to_workspace_kept: This organization does not let its containers be copied outside it: they copy into its own workspaces only.
board_join_hint: You read this board without being a member. Join it to write in it.
board_join_hint_as: You read this board without being a member. Joining makes you one, as {role}.
today_hub_subtitle: Your cards, learning units, reviews, and meetings across open workspaces.
today_hub_empty: You are all caught up for today.
new_visibility_open: Open — anyone in {workspace} can read and find it right away
new_kind_course_hint: To keep up with progress and reviews
account_api_tokens_hint: Keys that let an agent read or write the content of your workspaces as you. A token is shown once, when it is made.
account_api_tokens_own_space: My own space too (not its diaries)
account_api_tokens_own_space_password: Enter your password to give your own space.
account_api_tokens_made: The token is made. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
account_api_tokens_command: The command that connects Claude Code
account_api_tokens_history: The command stays in your shell history. On a shared device, remove it from the history after running it.
account_api_tokens_sign_in_again: Sign in again to give your own space.
account_api_tokens_disallowed: The organization of a workspace you chose does not allow API tokens.
account_api_tokens_workspaces_invalid: A workspace you chose cannot be given to a token.
org_api_tokens_allow: Allow API tokens with single sign-on
org_api_tokens_allow_hint: For an organization that takes only its single sign-on. On, members may give its workspaces to an agent's token, for 90 days at most; off, such tokens open nothing of it.
org_api_tokens_revoke_title: Take the token {name} out of this organization?
org_api_tokens_revoke_info: From now on the token opens no workspace of this organization. What it reaches elsewhere is its owner's to end.
account_api_tokens_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select it and copy it yourself.
account_api_tokens_notify_self: Tell me of what the agent does too
account_api_tokens_notify_self_hint: Its comments on what you watch, its mentions of you and the cards it gives you. Nothing is told in your own space.
account_api_tokens_revoke_info: From now on an agent that uses it opens nothing.
account_api_tokens_leave_info: Once you make a new token, the one shown now cannot be seen again.
audit_api_tokens_enabled: {actor} allowed API tokens with single sign-on
audit_api_tokens_disabled: {actor} stopped API tokens with single sign-on
audit_api_token_revoked: {actor} took {subject}'s API token {prefix}… out of the organization
account_api_tokens_too_many: You have too many live tokens. End one you do not use, then make this one.
account_api_tokens_provider_changed: Your organization's provider has changed since you signed in through it. Sign in through it again, then make the token.
